d:
Deep within the dense tropical jungles of the Americas, a brief respite from the relentless rainy season sets off a fierce war for survival, food, and dominance. In this full episode of Primal Combat from Nat Geo Animals, witness high-stakes animal clashes along the jungle riverbanks: poison dart frogs battling to the death, coatis braving venomous tarantulas to reach ripe fruit, and a dramatic showdown between an apex predator jaguar and a razor-toothed caiman fighting for territory. Along these jungle rivers, animals battle every day for survival.
Primal Combat | S1 E3 "Jungle River"
